list.name: vhost
list.description: Wildcard (*.example.com) and regex-named server blocks are excluded: their traffic attributes to concrete Host headers, which appear here once observed.

panels.title: $vhost — VIP HOLDER

targets.expr: max by (vrid, node) (nginx_fleet_vrrp_master == 1) and on (vrid) max by (vrid) (nginx_fleet_cluster_info{instance=~"${instance:pipe}"} and on (instance) max by (instance) (nginx_fleet_vhost_info{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}"}))

panels.description: Node currently advertising as VRRP master for the selected vhost's cluster, observed on the wire (one row per VRID; node is the advert source address). Gated to VRIDs the selected instance participates in and vhosts it serves.

panels.title: BLACKHOLE
panels.description: Nodes that hold the VIP (VRRP master) but have zero nginx worker processes — traffic arrives and nothing serves it. This is the exact failure mode of the manual nginx-stop test. Anything above 0 is an outage.

panels.title: SPLIT BRAIN

targets.expr: count(count by (vrid) (max by (vrid, node) (nginx_fleet_vrrp_master{instance=~"${instance:pipe}"}) == 1) > 1) or vector(0)

panels.description: More than one node advertising as VRRP master for the same VRID, heard on the wire. Anything above 0 means both pair members think they own the VIP: clients split between them, state diverges. Usually a network partition or keepalived misconfig. Investigate immediately; this is the one number on this wall that should always be 0.

panels.title: 5XX RATE

defaults.noValue: no traffic observed since exporter start

panels.description: Percentage of all requests (fleet-wide) returning 5xx. Goes red at 5%.

panels.title: UPSTREAMS DOWN

targets.expr: count(max by (vhost, upstream_addr) (nginx_fleet_upstream_up{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}"}) == 0 and (time() - max by (vhost, upstream_addr) (nginx_fleet_upstream_last_fail_timestamp_seconds{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}"})) < 900) or vector(0)

defaults.noValue: no traffic observed since exporter start

panels.description: Members of the selected vhost whose most recent evidence is a failure seen within the last 15m. Scoped to the vhost dropdown like every other panel.

panels.title: IDLE > 5 DAYS

targets.expr: count((time() - max by (vhost, upstream_addr) (nginx_fleet_upstream_last_traffic_timestamp_seconds{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}"})) > 432000) or vector(0)

defaults.noValue: no traffic observed since exporter start

panels.description: Upstream members of the selected vhost(s) with no observed traffic for over 5 days (the --decommission-window). The idle clock counts from last observed request and survives exporter restarts; configured-but-never-used members are seeded from config so they age too. A member idle this long is a decommission candidate: config says it exists, evidence says nothing uses it.

panels.title: EXPORTERS DOWN
panels.description: Fleet nodes whose nginx-fleet-exporter is not answering scrapes — monitoring blind spots, not necessarily service failures.

panels.title: $vhost — live topology: vhost → VIP → upstreams (req/s)

targets.expr: (sum by (source, target) (label_replace(label_replace((sum by (vhost) (rate(nginx_fleet_ingress_requests_total{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}"}[5m])) or max by (vhost) (nginx_fleet_vhost_info{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}"}) * 0) * on (vhost) group_left (listen_addr) topk by (vhost) (1, max by (vhost, listen_addr) (nginx_fleet_vhost_info{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}", listen_addr!=""})), "source", "$1", "vhost", "(.*)"), "target", "$1", "listen_addr", "(.*)"))) or (sum by (source, target) (label_replace(label_replace((sum by (vhost, upstream_addr) (rate(nginx_fleet_upstream_requests_total{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}"}[5m])) or max by (vhost, upstream_addr) (nginx_fleet_vhost_info{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}", upstream_addr!=""}) * 0) * on (vhost) group_left (listen_addr) topk by (vhost) (1, max by (vhost, listen_addr) (nginx_fleet_vhost_info{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}", listen_addr!=""})), "source", "$1", "listen_addr", "(.*)"), "target", "$1", "upstream_addr", "(.*)"))) or (sum by (source, target) (label_replace(label_replace((sum by (vhost, instance) (rate(nginx_fleet_ingress_requests_total{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}"}[5m])) unless on (vhost) max by (vhost) (nginx_fleet_vhost_info{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}", listen_addr!=""})) * on (instance) group_left (vip) max by (instance, vip) (nginx_fleet_cluster_info), "source", "$1", "vhost", "(.*)"), "target", "$1", "vip", "(.*)"))) or (sum by (source, target) (label_replace(label_replace((sum by (vhost, upstream_addr, instance) (rate(nginx_fleet_upstream_requests_total{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}"}[5m])) unless on (vhost) max by (vhost) (nginx_fleet_vhost_info{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}", listen_addr!=""})) * on (instance) group_left (vip) max by (instance, vip) (nginx_fleet_cluster_info), "source", "$1", "vip", "(.*)"), "target", "$1", "upstream_addr", "(.*)")))

defaults.noValue: no traffic observed since exporter start

panels.description: Traffic flows vhost -> listen VIP -> upstream members; weights are req/s from access-log evidence, zero-weight edges are configured-but-quiet. Vhosts without an address-bound listener draw direct vhost -> upstream edges.

panels.title: $vhost — requests by status

defaults.noValue: no traffic observed since exporter start

panels.description: Request rate for the selected vhost(s) by status class (2xx-5xx), from the fleet access log. A rising 5xx band with steady 2xx = backend failures; total collapsing to zero = traffic stopped reaching this vhost entirely (check VIP HOLDER and topology).

panels.title: $vhost — upstream members

defaults.noValue: no traffic observed since exporter start

panels.description: Every upstream member observed serving the selected vhost(s): request total (includes proxy_next_upstream retries, so a member being hammered by retry storms shows its true received load), failure count, evidence-based up/down, and time since last traffic.

panels.title: $vhost — upstream latency & failures

defaults.noValue: no traffic observed since exporter start

panels.description: Per-member response time (from $upstream_response_time) alongside failure rate by reason (next_upstream = skipped mid-request via retry, http_502/503/504 = failed final). Latency climbing while failures stay flat = saturation; failures without latency = fast rejects (connection refused, sealed vault, dead port).

panels.title: $vhost — configured listeners & backends
panels.description: The intended topology from the parsed nginx config: every listener and configured backend for the selected vhost(s), with the config file that defines it. Compare against the upstream members table: configured here but absent there = never receives traffic; there but not here = config drift or stale DNS.

panels.title: $vhost — KEEPALIVED MASTER

targets.expr: max by (vrid, node) (nginx_fleet_vrrp_priority) and on (vrid) max by (vrid) (nginx_fleet_cluster_info{instance=~"${instance:pipe}"} and on (instance) max by (instance) (nginx_fleet_vhost_info{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}"}))

panels.description: Advertised priority of the current master for the selected vhost's cluster. Watch it drop when a health check demotes a node.

panels.title: $vhost — upstream load over time

defaults.noValue: no traffic observed since exporter start

panels.description: Stacked request rate per member. The band widths are the load split; a member's band vanishing while others grow = traffic shifted off it (down, demoted, or drained).

panels.title: $vhost — TLS certificate per node (rows disagreeing = drift between pair members)
panels.description: Certificate actually served per pair member (SNI probe against the local listener). Rows disagreeing = drift between pair members. Negative days = expired. Standbys skip listeners bound to a VIP they don't hold, so one row per vhost is normal on address-bound listeners.

defaults.noValue: no TLS listeners configured for this vhost

panels.title: $vhost — VIP MOVES
panels.description: How many times this vhost's serving role moved between the two nginx instances of its cluster, within the dashboard time range (failovers + failbacks, counted once each, observer-deduplicated). Exporter restarts can slightly inflate this via counter resets.

targets.expr: sum(max by (vrid, from_node, to_node) (increase(nginx_fleet_vrrp_transitions_total{from_node!=""}[$__range])) and on (vrid) max by (vrid) (nginx_fleet_cluster_info and on (instance) max by (instance) (nginx_fleet_vhost_info{vhost=~"${vhost:pipe}"}))) or vector(0)
